name: gothic-nocturne
description: A 32-bit era gothic side-scrolling action platformer with multi-layer parallax, generated pixel art and a Lyria 3 score.

scripts.check: node --check server.mjs && for f in src/*.js src/engine/*.js src/game/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && python3 -m py_compile tools/forge_server.py && echo syntax ok
